name: Zyflora Media Share Widget
author: Bjjoha

sections.description:
Zyflora Media Share Widget makes it easy to add share and embed functionality to your media content.

The plugin adds a Gutenberg block that can be placed below images or videos, allowing visitors to copy an embed code or share the content using a clean, lightweight interface.

It is designed to be simple, fast, and fully compatible with modern block-based WordPress sites.

Key features:

  • Add a media share widget below images or videos
  • Copy embed code for easy reuse
  • Works seamlessly with the Gutenberg editor
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • No external tracking or third-party scripts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zyflora-media-share-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Gutenberg editor and add the Zyflora Media Share Widget block below your media content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin add tracking or analytics scripts?

No. The plugin does not add any tracking, analytics, or third-party scripts.

Does it work with both images and videos?

Yes. The widget can be used with images, videos, and embedded YouTube content.

Is this plugin compatible with the block editor only?

Yes. This plugin is designed specifically for the Gutenberg block editor.

Can I style the widget?

The widget uses a clean default style that works with most themes. Advanced customization can be done using custom CSS.
